content: expo-sqlite 57.0.3: sync API fully supported (openDatabaseSync, runSync, getAllSync, withTransactionSync, withExclusiveTransactionAsync, prepareSync). SQLiteOpenOptions: enableChangeListener (default false), useNewConnection. withExclusiveTransactionAsync is the safe transaction (queries must run on txn). useSQLiteContext + SQLiteProvider exist. No New Architecture caveats on the page.
